 F1 2026 US Grand Prix: Full starting grid after multiple penalties
 The full starting grid for the 2026 Formula 1 United States Grand Prix.
 Lewis Larkam Updated: 25 Oct 2026 Share Franco Colapinto is among several drivers taking penalties Prefer Crash.Net on Google See our stories more often Add This is the full starting grid for the 2026 Formula 1 United States Grand Prix at COTA. 
 Andrea Kimi Antonelli starts from pole position at the United States Grand Prix on the weekend he can potentially clinch his first Formula 1 world title. 
 The Mercedes driver is joined on the front-row of the grid by Red Bull’s Max Verstappen. 
 20-year-old Antonelli will be crowned F1’s youngest-ever world champion on Sunday if he wins with Lewis Hamilton lower than fourth and George Russell lower than eighth. 
 The top three qualifiers at the United States Grand Prix Article continues below ADVERTISEMENT Article continues below ADVERTISEMENT Isack Hadjar goes from third in the other Red Bull, ahead of the Ferrari pair of Charles Leclerc in fourth and Hamilton in fifth. 
 Russell lines up alongside Hamilton on the third row in sixth, ahead of the McLaren duo of Oscar Piastri and Lando Norris. 
 Liam Lawson and Pierre Gasly complete the top-10 starters. 
 Arvid Lindblad serves a five-place grid penalty for moving onto his sixth internal combustion unit of the year, meaning the Racing Bulls driver will start 14th. 
 Franco Colapinto drops 10 places to for taking a fourth control electronics in his Alpine.

 Bortoleto is set to start at the back of the Austin grid Gabriel Bortoleto will start at the very back of the grid after being hit with a mammoth 60-place penalty. 
 Ahead of final practice, the FIA confirmed Bortoleto’s Audi had been fitted with a new ICE, turbocharger, exhaust, MGU-K and power unit ancillary component. 
 Aston Martin has elected to start Lance Stroll from the pitlane after making set-up changes and replacing his PU and battery.
